root_idea.summary: A root principle of reaching out to take, obtain, or attain something.
root_idea.development: The lexical family extends this orientation from reaching and taking to reciprocal reaching in combat, causing attainment, and drawing someone out of destruction in a derived form.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Displayed under the normalized verbal-noun citation form تَنَاوُشٌ rather than the inflected Quranic surface form.

senses.definition: Reaching or attaining something; in the Quranic expression, attaining faith from a distant place.
senses.usage_conditions: The occurrence describes seeking or attaining faith only belatedly, after the opportunity for near and effective belief has passed.

senses.definition: Returning to, or recovering, faith that has been lost or missed.
senses.usage_conditions: An explicitly reported alternative interpretation of the same Quranic expression at 34:52, understanding the belated attainment as a return or recovery rather than simply an act of reaching.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To cling or cleave to someone or something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form I construction with بِـ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To cause someone to attain good or evil.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used transitively in the construction نُشْتُهُ خَيْرًا or شَرًّا.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To reach or thrust at one another with spears or other weapons.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reciprocal combat construction for opposing parties who are near, but not close together.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To mix with or engage in a thing.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form III construction; the evidence does not restrict the object class.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To bring, lead, or draw someone out of destruction and rescue him.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form VIII causative/rescuing use involving removal from a place or condition of destruction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A man characterized by might, strength, courage, valour, or prowess.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The noun also has the reported variant نَؤُوشٌ.

lane_unit_coverage.note: The unit supplies the reach/attain sense and the Quran-specific return interpretation.
Clinging or cleaving is independently represented.
The causative attainment construction is represented.
Reciprocal spear-reaching in combat is represented.
The distinct engage-or-mix use is represented.
Pointer-only cross-reference to the Form I entry.
The Form VI combat construction is covered by the represented reciprocal spear-reaching meaning.
Pointer-only cross-reference to the Form I entry.
The Form VIII rescue-from-destruction use is represented.
The noun for a strong or valiant man is represented.

cautions: The Quran occurrence is independently located by QAC at 34:52:6; the historical citation notation in the lexical evidence is not treated as a modern verse location.
The reported hamzated reading belongs to a variant and etymological discussion and is not presented as a separate Quranic form here.
